create.name: Duck Xiangqi: a sample game, annotated
create.description: Fairy-Stockfish against itself at full strength, eight seconds a move, read again by Fairy-Stockfish. From the Duck Xiangqi rules page at mistboard.com/rules/duck-xiangqi.

chapter.name: Fairy-Stockfish against itself, eight seconds a move

children.text: e1-e2: the chariot takes the general. There is no checkmate in Duck Xiangqi; a game ends when a general is captured, and the move that does it places no duck.

comments.text: The duck again: the engine plays the same g3-g2 with the duck on f3, not f2. A 19-point drop, and the horse falls on move 33.
The engine's choice: the same cannon move, the duck on f3.
The horse retreats to d4. Two moves later it goes to c2, and Black's chariot takes it there.
The engine's choice.
Black answers with the chariot to d7, where the engine would play f7-f3.
The engine's choice.
The chariot steps to h7 and goes straight back to h8 on move 27. A lost turn, and a 25-point drop.
The engine's choice.
The right horse move with the duck on the wrong point. The engine plays the same g3-f5 and puts the duck on f6; on g9 it costs Red 26 points.
The engine's choice: the same horse move, the duck on f6.
Black's chariot steps to g7. The engine would take the elephant on e3 with the cannon, and Black's chances drop by 19 points without it.
The engine's choice: the cannon takes the elephant.
The cannon leaves c7 for f7 and retreats to f2 two moves later. A 19-point drop.
The engine's choice.
i1-i3: the chariot takes the horse back.
g4-i3: Black's horse takes the cannon.
The cannon steps to i3, where Black's horse takes it on move 14. Red wins the horse back with the chariot on move 16, but Red's chances drop by 27 points.
The engine's choice.
Black's cannon goes to the edge on a6. The engine would bring an advisor up to e9 first.
The engine's choice.
The elephant comes up to e3. The engine would play g1-e3 with the duck on b2; this one costs 11 points.
The engine's choice.
The other cannon takes a soldier on c7: a second soldier for Red, but the raid costs 10 points.
The engine's choice.
The cannon that took a soldier on e7 swings to h7. The engine would put it on g7, and Red's chances drop by 11 points.
The engine's choice.
e3-e7: the cannon takes the middle soldier.

Fairy-Stockfish against itself at eight seconds a move, read again by the same engine. Its score leans toward the side to move, so each move is graded against the engine's best move from the same position, and every mark held up when that position was searched again for 12 seconds. Inaccuracies are left unmarked: two searches of one move differ by more than their width. Twice Red plays the engine's own piece move and puts the duck on the wrong point.
